extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: light tow truck (approx. 7.5 t) with rear crane boom and wheel lift, approx. 7.3 x 2.3 x 2.9 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.9 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 'tow-truck_boom' (crane boom with cylinder rod) is a separate object with its origin on the boom pin (rotate around local X, a positive angle raises it; the winch rope belongs to the boom); 'tow-truck_hook' (rope, hook block, hook) has its origin at the boom sheave and can be kept hanging; 'tow-truck_underlift' (wheel lift arm with spectacle cradles) is a separate object with its origin on the hinge at the rear frame (rotate around local X, a positive angle raises it); the lift cylinder is split (barrel on the bed, rod on the boom); 4 wheels (rear dual) are separate objects with origin on the axle; two amber beacons on the light bar glow softly; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
